long_biography.plain_text:
Market Focus Direct became Paul Gaynor's platform for turning consumer data into practical retail advertising. He developed proprietary applications for handling large datasets, while the business combined analytics with digital marketing, direct mail and flyer-distribution management. That hybrid model linked software development to the daily work of identifying audiences and directing advertising budgets more precisely.

Ciscom's acquisition moved Gaynor from company president into group governance. He joined the buyer's board, later chairing it during a leadership transition that included the appointment of a new chief executive and finance chief. The board vacated his chair in 2025 as it recruited additional expertise, retaining him as an independent director and audit-committee member; shareholders re-elected him in 2026.
